answer: Because your car is paid off, we need a duplicate title before we can complete the purchase, and the duplicate rules of the state that issued the title apply, not Georgia's. If your title was issued by Texas, Texas rules apply. The help center doesn't say how long a Texas duplicate takes, so please contact a store for that timing. Meanwhile, you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait for the duplicate.

facts.fact: the duplicate rules of the state that issued the title (Texas) apply
Texas titles are electronic, so for the sale you usually don't need a printed duplicate
a printed Texas duplicate takes 5 to 7 business days online
